title: 第7章 石塔第二层第8章 神丹道
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 感受到莫阳身上透发出来的气息，太上长老身形微微停顿。
随即一脸不爽的开口道：“地玄境二阶，你怎么不继续隐藏了，看上去你不服啊，老夫今天就打到你服！”
“老头，你别逼我！”莫阳全力催动体内的真气，开口怒喝。
“逼的就是你！”
随后，小院中风声骤起，两道身影在极速闪动，不断传出一道道交击声，一盏茶的时间后，莫阳身躯被拍飞出去。
莫阳稳住身形后胸膛剧烈的起伏，口中大口喘着粗气，交手虽然短暂，但不断运转灵虚步闪避，对他真气消耗极大。
他冷眼盯着太上长老，这老头虽然下手很重，但力道控制得恰到好处，并非真的要对他动手。
“小子，就这？”
“老夫还以为你要上天了，看在练武场上把你能的！”
太上长老收手而立，斜着眼睛朝莫阳冷嗤。
虽然他嘴上这么说，但心中却难以平静，这么多年来，他还是第一次见到莫阳这样妖孽的修者。
当年莫阳被四长老带回宗门的时候，他便感叹莫阳的悟性非凡，这也是发现莫阳能修行后他对莫阳如此在意的原因。
以至于他一心想将苏菲儿和莫阳撮合在一起！
因为他心中很清楚，想要留住莫阳，必须让莫阳有所牵挂。
四长老已经陨落，除此之外，他能想到的便只有苏菲儿。
这些年莫阳的性格他多少也知道一些，特别是四长老陨落后莫阳的各种表现，一旦莫阳心中有牵挂，哪怕终究会离开，但必定会和灵虚宗保持联系。
尚未等莫阳开口，太上长老抬手一挥，一个巴掌大小的盒子朝莫阳飞去，同时开口说道：“这是数年前老夫外出云游得到的一株灵草，你修为突破太快，服用它有助于稳固你的道基，小子，修行之路漫长，切勿心急！”
莫阳接到手中打开一看，木盒里面躺着一株干巴巴的灵参，他心中却吃惊不已，这种灵参极其难得，对修者来说有莫大的好处，想不到太上长老居然会直接给自己。
“老头，你到底想做什么？”莫阳皱眉看向太上长老。
所谓无事献殷勤，非奸即盗，他不得不提防。
“这是老夫给你的补偿，这些年来宗门对你确实有所亏欠，不过你也要想得通，别说我们灵虚宗，在整个玄天大陆上也一样，唯有强者才会有尊严，才有出路，弱者只会被淘汰，所以你一定要成为强者，别辜负四长老对你的期望！”
太上长老说完没有停留，转身便朝小院外走去。
莫阳看着那株灵参思索了许久，皱眉道：“这老家伙老奸巨猾，不会是故意激我把苏菲儿吃了吧，好以此将我留在灵虚宗……”
他抬头看向院外，无语的开口道：“老东西，你果然没安好心……还想激小爷吃肉，做你的春秋大梦去吧！”
随后他看了看手中的灵参，急忙转身走进了屋中，这白捡的宝贝得赶紧炼化，指不定哪天这老头又来抢回去。
而挑战赛结束，灵虚宗上下早已传得沸沸扬扬，不少弟子还不敢相信，居然连大师兄齐衡都败在莫阳手中。
关于莫阳的诸多猜测层出不穷，当然莫阳与苏菲儿的事情也被不断提起，亦是猜测诸多。
“可惜主峰徐师姐还在闭关，不然以徐师姐的性格，定然也要杀木峰！”
“徐师姐修为还未踏足地玄境，就算找上木峰，恐怕也不是莫阳的对手！”
content_en:
Feeling the aura coming from Mo Yang's body, the Supreme Elder paused slightly.
Then he said with a look of displeasure: "Second level of the Earth Profound Realm, why don't you continue to hide? It seems that you are not convinced. I will beat you until you do so today!"
"Old man, don't force me!" Mo Yang used all his strength to activate the zhenqi in his body and shouted angrily.
"You are the one who forced me!"
…
Then, there was a sudden sound of wind in the small courtyard, two figures flashed at high speed, and a series of clashing sounds were heard continuously. After a cup of tea, Mo Yang's body was shot and flew out.
After Mo Yang stabilized his body, his chest rose and fell violently, and he gasped for air. Although the fight was brief, the constant movement of Lingxu Steps to dodge consumed a lot of his energy.
He stared coldly at the Supreme Elder. Although the old man struck hard, his force was controlled just right and he didn't really want to attack him.
"Boy, is this it?"
"I thought you were going to heaven, let's see what you can do on the martial arts field!"
The Supreme Elder put back his hands and stood, squinting his eyes and sneering coldly at Mo Yang.
Although he said this, he couldn't calm down in his heart. This was the first time in so many years that he saw such a monster cultivator like Mo Yang.
When Mo Yang was brought back to the sect by the fourth elder, he lamented that Mo Yang had extraordinary understanding, which was why he cared so much about Mo Yang after discovering that Mo Yang could practice.
So much so that he wanted to bring Sophie and Mo Yang together!
Because he knew very well that if he wanted to keep Mo Yang, he had to make Mo Yang care.
The fourth elder had died, and apart from that, all he could think of was Sophie.
He has somewhat known Mo Yang's character over the years, especially Mo Yang's various behaviors after the death of the fourth elder. Once Mo Yang has concerns in his heart, even if he will eventually leave, he will definitely keep in touch with Lingxu Sect.
Before Mo Yang could speak, the Supreme Elder raised his hand and waved a palm-sized box towards Mo Yang. At the same time, he said: "This is a spiritual grass I got from traveling a few years ago. Your cultivation breakthrough is too fast. Taking it will help stabilize your Tao foundation. Boy, the road to cultivation is long, don't be impatient!"
Mo Yang took it in his hand and opened it. He saw a dry spiritual ginseng lying inside the wooden box. He was shocked. This kind of spiritual ginseng was extremely rare and of great benefit to cultivators. He never expected that the Supreme Elder would give it to him directly.
"Old man, what do you want to do?" Mo Yang frowned and looked at the Supreme Elder.
The so-called showing courtesy for nothing is either adultery or theft, so he had to be careful.
"This is the compensation I am giving you. The sect has indeed owed you something over the years, but you must also think about it. Not to mention our Lingxu Sect, it is the same in the entire Xuantian Continent. Only the strong will have dignity and a way out. The weak will only be eliminated, so you must become a strong one and don't let down the expectations of the fourth elders!"
The Supreme Elder didn't stop after saying that, turned around and walked out of the small courtyard.
Mo Yang looked at the spiritual ginseng and thought for a long time, frowned and said: "This old guy is so cunning, he didn't mean to provoke me to eat Sophie, so that he could keep me in Lingxu Sect..."
He raised his head and looked outside the courtyard, and said speechlessly: "Old man, you really have no good intentions... You still want to provoke me to eat meat, so go ahead and dream about your spring and autumn dreams!"
Then he looked at the spiritual ginseng in his hand and hurriedly turned around and walked into the house. This treasure he picked up for free had to be refined quickly, because the old man might come to snatch it back one day.
At the end of the challenge, the news had already spread throughout the Lingxu Sect, and many disciples still couldn't believe that even senior brother Qi Heng had been defeated by Mo Yang.
There are many speculations about Mo Yang. Of course, the matter between Mo Yang and Sophie is also constantly mentioned, and there are many speculations.
"It's a pity that the main peak, Senior Sister Xu, is still in retreat. Otherwise, with the character of Senior Sister Xu, she would definitely kill Mu Feng too!"
“Senior Sister Xu’s cultivation has not yet set foot in the Earth Profound Realm. Even if she comes to Mu Feng, I’m afraid she won’t be Mo Yang’s opponent!”
